label: Good
corporate_parent: Daikin Industries (Japan) — acquired Goodman in 2012. World's largest HVAC manufacturer. Also owns Amana (HVAC brand, NOT the appliance brand).

compressor.description: Copeland two-stage scroll compressor (ZP or ZPK series). Single compressor + solenoid valve = two-stage modulation (not two physical compressors). R-410A.
compressor.supplier: Copeland (Emerson/Copeland). Post-Daikin acquisition, Goodman retained Copeland on legacy platforms. Daikin compressors used in separate Daikin Fit/DX platform.
compressor.common_failures: Scroll tip seal wear (most common), liquid slugging (if TXV fails), internal relief valve stiction
compressor.replacement_cost: $600-900 parts; $1,800-3,000 fully installed with refrigerant recovery/recharge

condenser_coil.description: Traditional construction. NOT microchannel. Minimal corrosion coating on standard production.
condenser_coil.repairability: Brazeable — can be leak-repaired in field

expansion_device.description: TXV with external sensing bulb on suction line. Better load tracking than fixed orifice — 5-10% closer to rated SEER2 in real-world.
expansion_device.known_issues: Sensing bulb migration documented (not endemic to Goodman specifically)

fan_motor.description: ECM condenser fan motor. Composite blade.

control_board.board: Standard relay-type board. No brand-certified diagnostic tools required.
control_board.failure_modes: Capacitor aging (contactor cap most common), moisture intrusion on indoor AH board, relay stiction in cold climates

warranty.compressor_years: Lifetime (registered) — genuinely claimable post-Daikin. Covers compressor failure — Goodman replaces compressor, buyer pays labor + refrigerant.
warranty.claim_process: Contractor-friendly — Daikin warranty process rated easy by contractors. Mixed historical reports improving post-acquisition.

parts_availability.distribution: WIDEST IN INDUSTRY — GEMAIRE, Ferguson, Johnstone Supply all stock. Any supply house.

service_network.type: National wide independent — any HVAC contractor. Zero brand lock-in. Simplest service ecosystem.

durability_evidence.daikin_quality_narrative: Post-Daikin (2012+) quality meaningfully improved. Current units genuinely better than pre-acquisition 'builder-grade throwaway' reputation. Stigma lingers among older techs, but field evidence supports improvement.

platform_sharing.amana_identity: Amana = rebadged Goodman with enhanced warranty marketing. Same compressor, coil, cabinet. Different nameplate + better warranty positioning.
platform_sharing.daikin_separation: Daikin Fit/DX is SEPARATE platform from Goodman. Different compressor (Daikin vs Copeland), different architecture. Minimal component crossover.
platform_sharing.scoring_rule: Report must disclose Goodman=Amana badge engineering. Daikin Fit scored separately.

professional_consensus.installer_recommendation: Solid budget pick. Strong value. Best parts ecosystem in the industry.
professional_consensus.builder_grade_stigma: Even GSXC18 (mid-tier) carries Goodman stigma. Builder-grade perception persists despite post-Daikin improvements.
professional_consensus.volume_leader: Highest market share in residential HVAC new construction.

outlook_rationale: Daikin Industries (Japan) is world's largest HVAC manufacturer. Goodman acquisition in 2012 brought significant quality improvement. Strong corporate backing.
platform_disclosure: Amana HVAC = rebadged Goodman with enhanced warranty marketing. Same compressor, coil, cabinet. Daikin Fit/DX is SEPARATE platform — different compressor, different architecture.
bottom_line: Daikin-backed two-stage with lifetime compressor warranty and widest parts availability. Post-Daikin quality meaningfully improved. Copeland scroll, TXV, ECM fan. Non-communicating = zero brand lock-in. Builder-grade stigma persists but current units are genuinely solid. Represents strong value in mid-tier.

sources.snippet: Copeland two-stage scroll compressor (ZP/ZPK series). Single compressor + solenoid valve = two-stage. TXV expansion. ECM condenser fan. 22-26 gauge cabinet.
SEER2 18.0. HSPF2 8.5. Sound 68 dBA. ENERGY STAR certified. 67%/100% two-stage modulation.
Lifetime compressor warranty (registered) — genuinely claimable post-Daikin. Goodman replaces compressor, buyer pays labor + refrigerant. Widest parts in industry: GEMAIRE, Ferguson, Johnstone.
Non-communicating system. Standard 24V thermostat. Control board $300-600 parts, $600-1200 installed. Compressor replacement $600-900 parts, $1800-3000 installed.
Post-Daikin (2012+) quality meaningfully improved. Volume leader in new construction. Houston, TX and Fayetteville, TN manufacturing. Amana = same unit.
